# Architecture Decision Mini Guide

Use this mini-guide when choosing between multiple implementation approaches.

## Compare Options With These Criteria
- Delivery speed
- Complexity and maintainability
- Performance and scalability
- Security and compliance impact
- Migration and rollback complexity
- Operational burden

## Decision Table
| Option | Pros | Cons | Risk Level | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Option A |  |  | Low/Medium/High |  |
| Option B |  |  | Low/Medium/High |  |

## Rule of Thumb
Choose the option that is simplest to operate while still meeting success metrics and constraints.
